title: Réveil chez Gabriel  (Waking Up at Gabriel's)

segments.t: The morning after her arrival at Gabriel's apartment, Virginie wakes up feeling energized and playful. As Gabriel frets over the agency's uncertain future, Virginie teases him by offering private acting and singing lessons. Listen to the scene in French first. Don't worry about catching every word.
Ah, la dormeuse est enfin réveillée!
Bonjour Gabriel. Tu as du café?
Oui, prends une tasse dans la cuisine.
Si ton agence ferme, que vas-tu faire?
Je ne sais pas. Mon travail est ma sécurité.
Tu pourrais devenir un grand acteur.
Tu es complètement folle, Virginie!
Mais non! Je peux te donner des cours.
De la danse, du chant, de la comédie!
Le ciel est plus pur que mon cœur!
Tu veux juste te moquer de moi.
Tu seras magnifique sur scène.
Allez, on se met au travail tout de suite.
D'accord, je veux bien essayer.
Now let's break down the scene step by step. Listen to each line, followed by its meaning and a short explanation.
Ah, la dormeuse est enfin réveillée!
'Ah, the sleepyhead is finally awake!' Gabriel greets Virginie as she wakes up.
Bonjour Gabriel. Tu as du café?
'Good morning Gabriel. Do you have coffee?' She immediately looks for her morning dose of coffee.
Oui, prends une tasse dans la cuisine.
'Yes, take a cup in the kitchen.' Gabriel invites her to make herself comfortable.
Si ton agence ferme, que vas-tu faire?
'If your agency closes, what will you do?' She asks about his plans if the agency goes bankrupt.
Je ne sais pas. Mon travail est ma sécurité.
'I do not know. My job is my security.' Gabriel worries about losing his steady career.
Tu pourrais devenir un grand acteur.
'You could become a great actor.' Virginie teasingly proposes a dramatic career shift.
Tu es complètement folle, Virginie!
'You are completely crazy, Virginie!' Gabriel laughs at her absurd idea.
Mais non! Je peux te donner des cours.
'Not at all! I can give you lessons.' She eagerly offers to act as his private mentor.
De la danse, du chant, de la comédie!
'Dance, singing, comedy!' She lists the classic disciplines of stage performance.
Le ciel est plus pur que mon cœur!
'The sky is purer than my heart!' She recites a dramatic classical verse to demonstrate.
Tu veux juste te moquer de moi.
'You just want to make fun of me.' Gabriel suspects she is only trying to tease him.
Tu seras magnifique sur scène.
'You will be magnificent on stage.' She assures him that audiences will be dazzled.
Allez, on se met au travail tout de suite.
'Come on, let's get to work right away.' She enthusiastically pushes him to begin his training.
D'accord, je veux bien essayer.
'All right, I am willing to try.' Gabriel gives in playfully to her theatrical coaching. Now let's listen to the entire exchange once more from beginning to end.

Je ne sais pas. Mon travail est ma sécurité.

Mais non! Je peux te donner des cours.
De la danse, du chant, de la comédie!
Le ciel est plus pur que mon cœur!
Tu veux juste te moquer de moi.
Tu seras magnifique sur scène.
Allez, on se met au travail tout de suite.
D'accord, je veux bien essayer.
Virginie brightens Gabriel's morning with playful banter about his theatrical talents. Remember the versatile French expression for starting a task: se mettre au travail. See you next time!
Au revoir!
